EmailTemplate.name: FTF New Admit
EmailTemplate.subject: Congratulations on your admission to Arizona State University!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
As your personal admission counselor at Arizona State University, I am here to help you navigate the process and answer any questions you may have. Here is some information on your next steps.
Next steps for enrollment
- Pay your enrollment deposit on My ASU in your Priority Tasks box at https://my.asu.edu. - Apply for financial aid by filing your FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid) at htps://fafsa.ed.gov. - See a full list of next steps for enrollment at https://students.asu.edu/admitted.
<<ONLY KEEP THE FOLLOWING PARAGRAPHS IF RELEVANT TO THE STUDENT>>
Scholarships
- Use the scholarship estimator to see potential merit-based scholarships at https://scholarships.asu.edu/estimator. If you qualify for a scholarship, you will receive a letter in the mail approximately two weeks after you are admitted. - Apply for additional scholarships using ASU’s Scholarship Search Portal at https://scholarships.asu.edu/.
Barrett, The Honors College If you are interested in ASU's Barrett, The Honors College and have not yet applied, view admission and application information online at http://barretthonors.asu.edu/admissions/.
Congratulations again on your admission to ASU. If you have any questions, let me know and I’ll be happy to help!
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
